summary: Iter 19 — verified the discount% bugfix end-to-end. CUSTOMER GRID (/category/[slug]): all 5 migrated products render the discount row correctly with red 'X% OFF' (rgb(239,68,68)) + struck original + bold selling price — Chandan Fresh Mint Pan (5% OFF, struck 53 L, 50 L), Chandan Calcutta Meetha Paan (40% OFF, 83 L, 50 L), Dasmya Moisturizer Gel (10% OFF, 1611 L, 1450 L), Chandan Elaichi Saunf (2% OFF, 184 L, 180 L), and Haldiram Aloo Bhujia via the MRP path (29% OFF, struck 672 L, 480 L). PRODUCT DETAIL: /product/p-3bfd8c47b187 shows 40% OFF badge + struck 83 L + 50 L near price; footer add→stepper→inc/dec→0→ADD restore all work. ADMIN: login +355690000001 → /admin/products → edit Rajdhani Besan → modal contains 'Discount % (optional)' field next to 'MRP (LEK, optional)' (testIDs prod-modal-mrp/prod-modal-discount). Validation 150 → inline error 'Discount % must be between 0 and 99', modal stays open. Set 15 → save → customer grid (/category/flour) shows '15% OFF | struck 600 L | bold 510 L' (derived 510/0.85=600 ✓). Reverted to 0 via UI → grid shows plain 510 L, no OFF row. REGRESSION: 29/30 snack cards (all except Haldiram) show no OFF row; grid ADD→stepper works on non-discounted product. Backend data verified via public API: 5 discounted products intact, Rajdhani Besan cleanly reverted (discount 0, mrp null).

issues: Struck original price hardcodes Lek suffix ('{Math.round(discStruckLek)} L') instead of formatPrice() — shows 'L' even in EUR currency, inconsistent with the category grid which now uses formatPrice. Reference: app/product/[id].tsx:93

At 390x844 mobile-web viewport the sticky Save button sits outside the viewport and a normal tap fails ('element outside of viewport' even after scroll-into-view); had to JS-dispatch the click in tests. Likely web-preview-only (native Modal is fine on device) but worth checking on a real phone browser.

Clearing the Discount % field to empty does NOT clear an existing discount — frontend omits empty discount from the PATCH body (app/admin/products.tsx:421-425) and backend skips null fields (routes/admin_products.py:98), so the old value persists. Admin must type 0 to remove a discount. Minor UX gap.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Discount bugfix fully verified; nothing blocking. Practical notes: (1) Category slugs are mukhwas/personal_care/mithai (not mouth-fresheners). (2) Admin modal Save button is outside viewport at 390x844 in web preview — use JS-dispatched click (document.querySelector('[data-testid=prod-modal-save]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}))) or a taller viewport. (3) Detail pages keep the underlying category screen mounted, so duplicate testIDs exist — always use ':visible' + .last locators on /product/[id]. (4) Struck prices render without thousands separators (e.g. '1611 L' not '1,611 L'). (5) Empty discount field does not clear an existing discount; use 0.
rca_of_issue: Original bug RCA (confirmed fixed): user entered percentage values into the MRP field; since mrp(5/40/10/2) < price, discountInfo() returned null and no OFF row rendered. Fix adds a dedicated Discount % field (validated 0-99), a discountInfo() fallback that derives the struck original from discount%, matching detail-page rendering, and a data migration setting discount=<pct> + mrp_lek=null on the 4 misentered products. Verified all four products + the genuine-MRP Haldiram case render correctly.
